phases.label: Passive discovery
phases.description: No packet to the target: third-party data and DNS.

phases.label: Active discovery
phases.description: Enumerates the live surface: ports, HTTP services, crawling.

phases.label: Assessment
phases.description: Finds weaknesses on known surface: templates, DAST, SAST, SCA, IaC, posture.

phases.label: Validation
phases.description: Proves exploitability or reachability, or retests a finding.

phases.label: Collection
phases.description: Pulls assets and findings from another product or a file.

capabilities.name: Subdomain discovery
capabilities.description: Find subdomains of a root domain from passive sources.

params.name: sources
params.description: Passive sources to query; empty means the tool's defaults.

params.name: recursive
params.description: Also enumerate subdomains of found subdomains.

params.name: max_results
params.description: Stop after this many names per root domain.

capabilities.name: Passive intelligence
capabilities.description: Names, ranges and addresses from certificate transparency and passive DNS data.

capabilities.name: DNS resolution
capabilities.description: Resolve names to addresses and aliases.

params.name: record_types
params.description: DNS record types to query.

params.name: wildcard_filter
params.description: Drop names that only resolve through a wildcard record.

capabilities.name: Domain registration lookup
capabilities.description: Registrar, registrant organization, name servers and registration dates of a root domain, from the RDAP service of its registry.

params.name: follow_registrar
params.description: Also ask the registrar RDAP service the registry answer links to (registrant details a thin registry does not hold).

capabilities.name: Network ownership lookup
capabilities.description: Origin autonomous system, its holder and the announced range of an address or network, from public routing data; optionally the other ranges the same system announces.

params.name: include_announced
params.description: Also report the other ranges the origin system announces, as discovered networks.

params.name: max_ranges
params.description: Report at most this many announced ranges per autonomous system.

capabilities.name: Port scan
capabilities.description: Find open TCP ports (connect scan).

params.name: ports
params.description: Ports and port ranges to scan.

params.name: top_n
params.description: Scan the N most common ports instead of a list.

params.name: protocol
params.description: Transport protocol.

params.name: rate
params.description: Maximum requests per second.

capabilities.name: Service detection
capabilities.description: Identify the service, product and version behind an open port.

capabilities.name: HTTP probe
capabilities.description: Probe web services: status, title, technologies, TLS certificate.

params.name: ports
params.description: Ports to probe when the input is a hostname or an address.

params.name: follow_redirects
params.description: Follow redirects on the same host.

params.name: tech_detect
params.description: Detect the technologies a page uses.

params.name: tls_grab
params.description: Record the TLS certificate.

params.name: api_schema
params.description: Fetch API schema documents (OpenAPI, GraphQL introspection) at well-known paths and report their operations as endpoints.

capabilities.name: Technology fingerprint
capabilities.description: Identify the technologies a web service or service runs.

capabilities.name: TLS check
capabilities.description: Check certificates, protocols and ciphers.

capabilities.name: Screenshot
capabilities.description: Capture a screenshot of a web page.

capabilities.name: Web crawl
capabilities.description: Crawl web services for URLs, staying on the same host. Reports endpoints (CTIS 1.6), or discovered_url assets from producers before 1.6.

params.name: depth
params.description: Maximum crawl depth.

params.name: js_parse
params.description: Parse JavaScript for endpoints.

params.name: max_urls
params.description: Stop after this many URLs per start URL.

capabilities.name: Cloud resource discovery
capabilities.description: List the resources of a cloud account through its read-only API.

params.name: regions
params.description: Only these regions; empty means every region the account uses.

capabilities.name: Repository discovery
capabilities.description: List the repositories of a source-code organisation.

capabilities.name: Vulnerability templates
capabilities.description: Run non-intrusive vulnerability templates.

params.name: severity
params.description: Only templates of these severities.

params.name: tags
params.description: Only templates with these tags.

params.name: exclude_tags
params.description: Skip templates with these tags.

params.name: rate
params.description: Maximum requests per second.

capabilities.name: Web application scan
capabilities.description: Dynamic application security testing of a web application, or of the known endpoints of one.

params.name: profile
params.description: Scan depth.

params.name: max_duration_minutes
params.description: Stop the scan after this many minutes.

capabilities.name: Static analysis
capabilities.description: Static application security testing of source code.

params.name: languages
params.description: Only analyze these languages.

capabilities.name: Secrets in code
capabilities.description: Find committed secrets in a repository.

params.name: history
params.description: Scan the commit history, not only the current tree.

capabilities.name: Dependency scan
capabilities.description: Find vulnerable dependencies and build a component inventory.

params.name: dev_deps
params.description: Include development dependencies.

capabilities.name: Software bill of materials
capabilities.description: Build the component inventory of a repository or an image, without vulnerability matching.

params.name: dev_deps
params.description: Include development dependencies.

capabilities.name: Infrastructure-as-code misconfiguration
capabilities.description: Find misconfigurations in infrastructure-as-code files.

params.name: frameworks
params.description: Only these IaC frameworks.

capabilities.name: Container image scan
capabilities.description: Find vulnerabilities in a container image.

params.name: os_pkgs
params.description: Include operating-system packages.

capabilities.name: Cloud posture
capabilities.description: Read-only configuration review of a cloud account.

capabilities.name: Configuration benchmark
capabilities.description: Check a host or an account against a configuration benchmark.

capabilities.name: Credentialed host scan
capabilities.description: Authenticated vulnerability scan of a host.

capabilities.name: Network vulnerability assessment (connector)
capabilities.description: Run a network vulnerability scan through a connected scanner product.

params.name: policy
params.description: Scan policy name in the connected product.

capabilities.name: Verify a finding
capabilities.description: Retest a finding with a tool that can reproduce it. A web finding is retested at its finding.web location (URL, method, parameter). Used by retests, not as a workflow node.

params.name: mode
params.description: retest re-runs the rule that found it; exploit_check runs a safe proof without side effects.

capabilities.name: Subdomain takeover check
capabilities.description: Find names whose alias points at an unclaimed third-party resource.

capabilities.name: Credential exposure check
capabilities.description: Look up exposed credentials of the organisation in breach corpora; never a login attempt.

capabilities.name: Attack simulation
capabilities.description: Run attack scenarios on a host and report whether controls prevented or detected them.

capabilities.name: Import a file
capabilities.description: Read a report file of a known format (SARIF, CycloneDX, SPDX, Nessus, ...) into assets, findings and dependencies. Makes no network connection.

params.name: format
params.description: The file format; empty means detect it.

capabilities.name: Import an API specification
capabilities.description: Read an API specification (OpenAPI, GraphQL schema, Postman collection) into the endpoints of an origin. Makes no connection to the target.
